name: Fuwa Shuuichi
source: High school second grader, a student at Yahiro Gakuen. A friend of Suou's, Shuuichi is a bookworm who is fascinated by the paranormal, strange myths and lore. He can be cynical and sharp-tongued with anyone who isn't interested in his hobbies.
